tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nang so pu trar rdor gong phul ba'i zhal yi ge/ na mo gu ru shrī karma nā tha ye/ srab 'jam yang ba shin tu dri zhim pa'i/ /lha rdzas nam mkha' kha dog sna lnga pa/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul 'di/ /mon bu 'khor bcas dges pas bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dang dam tshig dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gis gsol btab rjes dgongs la/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan dang de 'dzin bcas/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi/ /nad mug 'khrug sogs mi mthun rgud tshogs sel/ /bde skyid dpal 'byor kun nas rgyas phyir du/ /'gro kun dge bcur ldan pa khyed kyis mdzod/ /khyad par 'khon rigs bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma dag zhing skyes nas srid mtha'i bar/ /sa bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /oṃ badzra wasatra ya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bi dyā swāhā/ oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe swāhā/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ nang so putrar rdor gong phul ba'i zhal yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
